_meta.note: Curated facts only. latest_news is refreshed by pipeline/refresh.py and must never be edited here. previous_ids lists retired _id values so history survives a rename.

companies.name: Anthropic
companies.intro: Anthropic is a frontier AI safety-focused research lab building the Claude family of large language models. Founded in 2021 by Dario and Daniela Amodei (former OpenAI leaders), the company has positioned itself as the safety-first alternative in the foundation model race, with a $965B post-money valuation as of May 2026 — making it the most valuable AI startup globally. Claude has become the de facto enterprise coding and reasoning model, with revenue run-rate reportedly exceeding $47B/month as of mid-2026.
companies.product: Claude is Anthropic's flagship product, available via Claude.ai (consumer chat), Claude API (developer platform), and Claude Code (autonomous coding agent that has emerged as a direct competitor to Cursor and OpenAI's Codex). The model family currently spans Claude Opus 4.8, Claude Sonnet 5, and Claude Haiku tiers, with deep integration across AWS (primary cloud), Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and direct enterprise contracts. Other key products: Model Context Protocol (MCP, open standard for agent-tool integration), Claude for Enterprise, Claude Science (AI workbench for researchers), Claude for Teachers, and the 'Mythos' cybersecurity model released in limited form to select organizations in April 2026.

funding.source_note: Series H at $965B post-money; co-led by Capital Group, Coatue, D1, GIC, ICONIQ, XN. Strategic investments include $5B from Amazon, plus commitments from Microsoft and Nvidia. Source: Anthropic newsroom, Reuters, NYT.

companies.name: OpenAI
companies.intro: OpenAI is the creator of ChatGPT, GPT, DALL·E, and Sora, and remains the highest-profile AI lab globally. Originally a non-profit, it restructured into a capped-profit company in 2019 and is widely expected to IPO in late 2026 at a valuation that has fluctuated between $500B and $852B across 2025-2026. With 700M+ weekly ChatGPT users and an aggressive model release cadence, OpenAI is the default reference point for the entire AI industry — and increasingly under regulatory and ethical scrutiny.
companies.product: OpenAI's product portfolio spans: ChatGPT (consumer chat, now including ads in US Free/Go tiers); GPT-5.4 (latest frontier model launched March 2026 with 1M token context, unified coding/reasoning/computer-use architecture, 75% OSWorld score); GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, Luna (latest series rolled out July 2026 in limited partner release at US government request); the OpenAI API for developers; Codex (now a flagship coding agent); Sora (video generation); o-series reasoning models; and vertical plays into health, scientific discovery, and commerce. Strategic cloud and compute partners include Microsoft (primary), plus Amazon, NVIDIA, and SoftBank.

funding.source_note: $122B committed capital at $852B post-money. Co-led by SoftBank, a16z, D.E. Shaw, MGX, TPG, T. Rowe Price. First retail participation via bank channels ($3B from individuals). $4.7B revolving credit facility from JPMorgan, Citi, Goldman, Morgan Stanley, etc. Source: OpenAI, CNBC.

companies.name: Cursor / Anysphere
companies.intro: Anysphere, operating under the Cursor brand, is the world's most valuable AI coding startup and the fastest SaaS company ever to $100M ARR (achieved in <12 months from Cursor's 2023 launch). Cursor is an AI-native IDE (built on a fork of VS Code) used by half of the Fortune 500 and 360K+ paying developers. After raising at a $50B+ valuation in April 2026 and reporting $4B+ ARR by June, Anysphere is now subject to a SpaceX acquisition option valued at $60B — pending regulatory approval and expected to close in Q3 2026.
companies.product: Cursor is an AI-native code editor that integrates code generation, autocomplete, smart rewrites, codebase-aware search, and autonomous coding agents directly into the IDE. The November 2025 launch of the proprietary Composer inference model reduced third-party model costs and brought the company to slight gross margin profitability. Cursor 3 (April 2026) introduced an AI agent experience that delegates entire programming tasks to autonomous agents, directly competing with Claude Code and OpenAI Codex. The product supports multi-model workflows (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI GPT, Moonshot Kimi — though Cursor's latest coding model disclosure on March 2026 acknowledged it was built atop Moonshot's Kimi, prompting transparency concerns).

funding.source_note: Series E at $50B pre-money, co-led by a16z and Thrive, with Nvidia as strategic co-investor (oversubscribed). Additionally, SpaceX obtained an option in April 2026 to acquire Cursor for $60B (all-stock), or alternatively pay $10B for a joint development partnership on Colossus-hosted coding AI. SpaceX exercised the option on June 16, 2026; deal expected to close Q3 2026. Source: CNBC, TechCrunch, Bloomberg.

companies.name: ElevenLabs
companies.intro: ElevenLabs is the leading AI voice platform, with the most realistic text-to-speech models in the world and a rapidly expanding enterprise voice-agent business. Founded in 2022 by ex-Google Mati Staniszewski and ex-Palantir Piotr Dąbkowski, the company has scaled to $500M+ ARR by May 2026 and is preparing for an IPO. Eleven v3 (their flagship conversational model) powers 1B+ end users through API integrations with Meta, Epic Games, Salesforce, MasterClass, and Harvey.
companies.product: Three core platforms: (1) ElevenAgents — enterprise voice/chat agents for customer support, sales, and internal workflows, with deployment at Deutsche Telekom, Square, Revolut, Ukrainian Government; (2) ElevenCreative — generative audio platform for creators and brands, with voice, music (ElevenMusic, launched April 2026), sound effects, and dubbing across 70+ languages; (3) ElevenAPI — low-latency production-grade voice infrastructure used by Meta, Epic Games, Salesforce, MasterClass, and Harvey. Recent additions: Ads Engine in ElevenCreative (June 2026), Flows Agent (June 2026), Procedures in ElevenAgents (June 2026), Dubbing v2 and Music v2 (May 2026), ElevenLabs for Government (Feb 2026), Google SynthID integration for AI audio detection.

funding.source_note: Series D closed Feb 2026 at $11B post-money ($500M raised). $100M prior tender offer at $6.6B in Sept 2025. Sept 30, 2026: $300M **employee tender offer** at $22B valuation (2x Series D), led by Wellington Management and T. Rowe Price, with new investors EQT, Goldman Sachs, GIC, OTPP, Sapphire Ventures, BDT & MSD alongside existing Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed, ICONIQ, D.E. Shaw, Evantic, DISRUPTIVE, Alkeon. Tender offers provide employee/shareholder liquidity without raising new capital for the company. Source: ElevenLabs blog, TechCrunch, Reuters, Economic Times (Sept 30, 2026).

companies.name: xAI
companies.hq: San Francisco, CA (data centers in Memphis, TN)
companies.intro: xAI is Elon Musk's AI company behind the Grok family of models, integrated tightly with X (the social platform acquired as part of the February 2026 SpaceX-xAI merger). Founded in 2023, xAI has scaled to one of the largest AI infrastructure footprints in the world — over 1M H100 GPU equivalents across the Colossus clusters in Memphis. Valued at $230B post-money in early 2026, xAI is preparing to launch Grok 5 and is positioning as the third major Western frontier lab alongside OpenAI and Anthropic.
companies.product: Product family: Grok 4 (current frontier model, 52% on Humanity's Last Exam, 'best-in-class training infrastructure powered by Colossus'); Grok 5 (in training, expected 2026); Grok Voice (real-time voice agent in dozens of languages, deployed via Grok app and Tesla vehicles); Grok Imagine (image and video generation model); Grok Business and Grok Enterprise (launched January 2026 with data vaults, encryption, audit logs, $25/$60 per user/month pricing); speech-to-text and text-to-speech APIs (April 2026). Backed by real-time data access through X, giving Grok a unique training and inference edge for current-events reasoning.

funding.source_note: Series E exceeded $15B target to reach $20B. Investors include Valor, Stepstone, Fidelity, Qatar Investment Authority, MGX, Baron Capital, with strategic investment from NVIDIA and Cisco Investments. Acquired by SpaceX in February 2026. Source: TechCrunch, The Guardian, Reuters.

companies.name: MiniMax
companies.intro: MiniMax (Hailuo AI) is a global AI foundation model company founded in early 2022. The company develops large language models, video generation, and conversational AI products serving both consumer and enterprise markets globally.
companies.product: Hailuo AI (video generation and conversational AI platform), Talkie (AI character companion app), Xingye (AI agent platform), and a suite of foundation models powering both B2C apps and B2B API services. MiniMax has rapidly scaled its product portfolio across video, conversational AI, and agentic tools.

funding.source_note: Multiple rounds in 2024-2025; valuation grew rapidly. Source: Reuters, August 2025.

companies.name: AI21 Labs
companies.intro: AI21 Labs is an Israeli AI company and enterprise-grade foundation model provider, building reliable large language models for business applications. Co-founded by Yoav Shoham (Stanford professor emeritus), Ori Goshen, and Amnon Shashua (Mobileye founder), the company focuses on trustworthy AI for production deployments.
companies.product: AI21 develops the Jamba family of foundation models (Jamba, Jamba 1.5, Jamba 1.6) — hybrid SSM-Transformer models offering strong performance with long context windows. Key products include AI21 Studio (developer API), Wordtune (consumer writing assistant), and enterprise solutions for finance, legal, and customer support.
companies.arr_source_note: AI21 Labs does not publicly disclose ARR.

funding.source_note: Series D in progress (Fintech Weekly, Apr 2026). Total raised to date ~$636M including Series C of $155M (Aug 2024). Source: AI21, Reuters, Fintech Weekly.

companies.name: Advanced Machine Intelligence (AMI)
companies.intro: Advanced Machine Intelligence (AMI) is a world-model AI lab founded by Yann LeCun, Turing Award winner and former Chief AI Scientist at Meta, after his departure from FAIR. AMI is Europe's largest seed-funded AI company, building world models based on LeCun's Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) that learn abstract representations of physical reality rather than predicting tokens.
companies.product: AMI is developing 'world models' — AI systems that understand the physical world through sensor and video data via JEPA (Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture). Target applications include industrial process control, robotics, automotive (potential integration with Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses), aerospace, biomedical, and pharmaceutical applications. No commercial product yet; first year is research-focused.
companies.arr_source_note: No revenue — pre-product research stage.

funding.source_note: Europe's largest seed round ever. Co-leads: Cathay Innovation, Greycroft, Hiro Capital, HV Capital, Bezos Expeditions. Also backed by NVIDIA, Temasek, Samsung, Toyota Ventures, Bpifrance, Jeff Bezos, Mark Cuban, Eric Schmidt, Tim Berners-Lee. Source: Reuters, Futurum Group.

companies.name: AvePoint
companies.intro: AvePoint is a public (NASDAQ: AVPT) data management, security, and governance platform provider focused on the Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace ecosystem. The company is positioning itself as the 'Confidence Platform' for enterprise AI deployment, providing data security, governance, and resilience capabilities critical to organizations deploying AI in production.
companies.product: AvePoint Confidence Platform with three core suites: Resilience Suite (data security, ransomware protection), Modernization Suite (legacy data transformation for SaaS), and Control Suite (automated governance). Recent products include AgentPulse Command Center (AI agent governance across M365 and Google Cloud). Serves ~$435M ARR with 9,000+ customers.
companies.arr_source_note: AvePoint Q1 2026 ARR $435.2M (public filing).

funding.source_note: Public company. Pre-IPO funding ~$100M. Market cap ~$2.23B as of May 2026. Source: AvePoint investor presentation, Q1 2026.

companies.name: BeyondMath
companies.intro: BeyondMath is a deeptech company pioneering 'Generative Physics' — the world's first foundational AI model trained on fundamental physical laws (Navier-Stokes for fluids, Fourier for heat, etc.) rather than internet data. The company targets engineering simulation use cases across automotive, aerospace, and energy sectors, slashing design iteration times from days to seconds.
companies.product: BeyondMath's generative physics model: a foundational transformer trained on universal physics laws. Use cases: generative design (AI proposing optimal geometries), multimodal digital twins (combining sims with sensor data), vertical modules for batteries, aerodynamics, structures. Targets $100M ARR by 2028, powering 20% of premium sim workflows. Trains on NVIDIA DGX H200.
companies.arr_source_note: Pre-revenue, projecting $100M ARR by 2028.

funding.source_note: Seed extension of $10M led by Cambridge Innovation Capital closes Seed at $18.5M. Initial $8.5M seed from 2024 led by UP.Partners. Source: BeyondMath press release, Feb 2026.

companies.name: Bottlecap AI
companies.intro: BottleCap AI is a European AI lab founded by Tomas Mikolov (creator of Word2Vec), Jaroslav Beck (co-creator of Beat Saber), and David Herel. The company is building efficiency-first large language models and an app development studio to commercialize them. Mikolov's return to active research with backing from major tech founders has drawn significant attention.
companies.product: CAP1 is BottleCap AI's in-house efficiency-focused foundational language model. First commercial app: Pulse (Community News) — an iOS app that aggregates and summarizes AI/tech news with community sentiment insights, built on CAP1. Future products will be B2B-focused AI tools for enterprises. Architecture designed for efficiency from the ground up.
companies.arr_source_note: Pre-revenue, just launched first consumer app.

funding.source_note: Seed led by 20VC. Angels include David Singleton (ex-Stripe CTO), Cliff Obrecht (Canva), Steffen Tjerrild Hansen (Synthesia), Ilkka Paananen (Supercell), Anton Osika (Lovable), Xavier Niel, Olivier Pomel (Datadog), Thomas Wolf (Huggingface), Des Traynor (Intercom). Source: Sifted, Oct 2025.

companies.name: Cantina AI
companies.intro: Cantina is an invitation-only social AI platform that blends social gaming with artificial intelligence in a 24/7 virtual club. Users interact with AI bots featuring distinct personalities, play games, and generate AI art. Backed by a who's who of Silicon Valley investors.
companies.product: Cantina app: subscription-based social AI platform. Features include AI characters with distinct personalities, chat, games, AI art generation, and an in-app video tool (launched May 2025) that brings AI characters to life with the latest video models. Bot behavior adapts to user inputs in real time. Target: tech-savvy users and brands seeking customized digital interactions.
companies.arr_source_note: Subscription model, not publicly disclosed.

funding.source_note: Total funding $33.3M across 2+ rounds. Notable investors: Kleiner Perkins, Andreessen Horowitz, Accel, Y Combinator, SV Angel, Founders Fund. Source: Simplify jobs board, Crunchbase.

companies.name: Causal Labs
companies.intro: Causal Labs is building physics-based AI models to address civilization-scale challenges, starting with weather prediction and control. Founded by former Cruise learning engineers, the company takes a physics-first approach to AI, integrating causal reasoning about atmospheric systems rather than relying on pattern matching alone.
companies.product: Physics-based AI models for weather prediction and control. The company's technology understands the mechanics of the atmosphere — cause-and-effect relationships and inherent uncertainties. Initial model focuses on weather/atmospheric prediction with the ability to not just forecast but 'interpret' predictions to suggest actions to achieve user goals. Plans pilot programs across critical industries.
companies.arr_source_note: Early-stage pre-revenue.

funding.source_note: $6M seed led by Kindred Ventures with Refactor, BoxGroup, Factorial, Otherwise, Karman Ventures. Source: BusinessWire, March 2025.

companies.name: Cognition AI
companies.intro: Cognition AI is the maker of Devin, the first autonomous AI software engineer. Founded by competitive programming medalists Scott Wu, Steven Hao, and Walden Yan, Cognition has scaled to $492M ARR in two years and counts Mercedes-Benz, Goldman Sachs, NASA, Citi, Dell, Santander, US Army, and Itaú among its enterprise customers. The company also acquired Windsurf in 2025.
companies.product: Devin: autonomous AI software engineer that plans architecture, writes implementation, runs tests, debugs, and ships pull requests without human hand-holding. Integrates with Slack, GitHub, Linear. SWE-1.6 model is one of the most widely used across the product suite. Pricing dropped from $500/mo to $20/mo + $2.25 per ACU in April 2026. 89% of Cognition's own codebase is now written by Devin.
companies.arr_source_note: Cognition AI Series D announcement, May 2026: $492M ARR.

funding.source_note: Series D >$1B at $26B post-money valuation, closed May 27 2026. Co-led by Lux Capital, General Catalyst, 8VC. Previous round was $400M at $10.2B post in September 2025. August 2026 Bloomberg report about $40B talks contingent on $1B ARR has not closed (current ARR ~$492M); do not count that as current valuation.

companies.name: Cohere
companies.intro: Cohere is a Canadian enterprise AI lab building secure, privacy-preserving foundation models for business. Co-founded by former Google researchers Aidan Gomez, Ivan Zhang, and Nick Frosst, the company has grown to 4,000+ enterprise customers with ARR exceeding $350M. The April 2026 Series D pushed the valuation to $14B, with the company also moving to acquire Germany's Aleph Alpha for European sovereign AI expansion.
companies.product: Command family of models (Command A, Command A+, Command R+, Command Vision) for enterprise use cases. Retrieval models Embed 4 and Rerank 3.5. North: Cohere's agentic AI platform for secure enterprise deployment. Deployable in customer cloud environments for data privacy. Key partnerships: Oracle, Dell, RBC, Bell, Fujitsu, LG CNS, SAP, Ensemble Health Partners. Joelle Pineau joined as Chief AI Officer in 2025.
companies.arr_source_note: Cohere Series D Apr 2026: ARR exceeding $350M.

funding.latest_round: Series D + Aleph Alpha acquisition financing
funding.source_note: April 2026 Series D $800M at $14B. Earlier $500M round at $6.8B. Schwarz Group investing $600M as part of Aleph Alpha acquisition deal. Total ~$1.6B. Source: AA Orbit, Reuters, Bloomberg.

companies.name: Databricks
companies.intro: Databricks is the leading Data and AI platform, founded by the creators of Apache Spark. In 2026, the company has aggressively scaled — hitting $6.9B ARR with 80% YoY growth, raising at a $165-175B target valuation after closing a $5B round at $134B in February 2026. AI products (Mosaic AI) alone generate $1.4B run-rate. Now signing term sheets for additional funding at $188B valuation (July 2026).
companies.product: Databricks Data Intelligence Platform: Unity Catalog, Lakebase, Mosaic AI (model training, fine-tuning, vector search, model serving, agent development). Agent Bricks for building production agents. Genie (natural language data queries). SAP integration. Hosts Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, and other frontier models via Mosaic AI Model Serving. 13,000+ customers including OpenAI, Stripe, Shell, Adobe, Rivian.
companies.arr_source_note: Databricks June 2026: $6.9B ARR (80% YoY growth). Source: Value Add VC.

funding.latest_round: Strategic round (in progress, term sheet signed)
funding.source_note: July 16, 2026: term sheet signed at $188B valuation. February 9, 2026: closed $5B at $134B (plus $2B debt). June 2026: in talks at $165-175B. Total raised ~$20.2B across 14 rounds, 110 investors. Source: Databricks press release, Reuters, Value Add VC.

companies.name: DataDog
companies.intro: Datadog (NASDAQ: DDOG) is the leading AI-powered observability and security platform, serving 33,200+ customers. Q1 2026 revenue crossed $1B for the first time ($1.006B, +32% YoY), with total ARR exceeding $4B. AI integrations now used by 6,500+ customers (20% of total) representing 80% of ARR. Five of 26 products are over $100M ARR each.
companies.product: Unified observability and security across infrastructure, applications, data, models. Key products: Bits AI (SRE Agent, Security Analyst, Dev Agent — autonomously analyzing alerts and generating fixes), GPU Monitoring, MCP Server (real-time access for AI agents), Experiments (A/B testing), Cloud SIEM. 4,550 customers with $100K+ ARR. Strategic partnerships with Sakana AI (Japan) and others.
companies.arr_source_note: Datadog Q1 2026 earnings: total ARR >$4B.

funding.source_note: Public company (NASDAQ: DDOG). Pre-IPO funding ~$147M. Current market cap ~$45B. Q1 2026 revenue $1.006B (+32% YoY). Total ARR >$4B. Source: Datadog Q1 2026 earnings.

companies.name: Decart
companies.intro: Decart is an Israeli AI research lab specializing in real-time video and world models. The company raised $300M at a $4B valuation led by Radical Ventures, with strategic backing from NVIDIA, Adobe Ventures, Toyota Ventures, and OpenAI co-founder Andrej Karpathy. Decart's core innovation is a real-time inference stack (DOS) that makes world models production-viable.
companies.product: Three products built on DOS infrastructure: (1) DOS 2.0 — optimization platform for AI workloads, processing 1,600+ tokens/sec (8x industry average) for agents and 100 FPS for video. (2) Lucy — real-time world model for video modification (sub-30ms response for smart mirrors, virtual try-on, gaming). (3) Oasis — 3D environment generator for robotics training and simulation. Customers include Amazon, eBay, Twitch creators.
companies.arr_source_note: Generating 'significant revenue' from DOS licensing; specific ARR undisclosed.

funding.source_note: $300M at nearly $4B valuation, led by Radical Ventures with NVIDIA, Adobe Ventures, Toyota Ventures, eBay Ventures. Angels: Andrej Karpathy, Michael Eisner. Total raised >$450M including prior. Source: SiliconAngle, May 2026.

companies.name: Deepgram
companies.intro: Deepgram is the real-time voice AI API platform powering 1,300+ organizations including Granola, Vapi, Twilio, and Salesforce. The company raised a $130M Series C in January 2026 at a $1.3B valuation, with all major existing investors (Alkeon, In-Q-Tel, Madrona, Tiger, Wing, Y Combinator, BlackRock) participating alongside new strategic investors (Twilio, ServiceNow Ventures, SAP, Citi Ventures).
companies.product: Aura-2 (enterprise text-to-speech), Nova-3 (real-time speech-to-text), Flux (conversational speech recognition with interruption handling), Voice Agent API, Saga (Voice OS). 200,000+ developers build with Deepgram. Deployed via cloud APIs or self-hosted. Recent acquisition: OfOne (AI-native voice for restaurants, 95% containment, serving QSR drive-thrus).
companies.arr_source_note: Deepgram does not publicly disclose ARR.

funding.source_note: Total raised >$215M (TechCrunch). Series C $130M at $1.3B. Previous Series B $72M. Source: Deepgram, TechCrunch, January 2026.

companies.name: Enigma
companies.intro: Enigma is a physical AI research lab building foundation models (GEN-1) and proprietary robotic arms for human-robot interaction. Founded in January 2025 by former Unit 8200 researchers Jonathan Jacobi (CEO, Microsoft's youngest-ever employee) and Gal Niv (CTO). Emerged from stealth in July 2026 with a $71M seed round — one of the largest seed financings in Israeli startup history. Approach: invert the capability-first robotics paradigm by running 100+ robots in hangars in Israel and California, where anyone can interact with them to study how humans naturally communicate with machines. Investors include OpenAI/Anthropic/xAI/Cognition executives and researchers.
companies.product: Two main products: (1) GEN-1 — foundation AI model for robotics, designed to make robots more intelligent, adaptable, and easier to deploy across diverse hardware. (2) Proprietary robotic arms (hardware) used both as the company's research platform and to collect the training data for GEN-1. The 100+ robot fleet runs public-facing experiments (painting, sword fighting, chemistry) to gather natural human-robot interaction data at scale. Bet: the bottleneck in robotics isn't smarter robots, it's making them usable — analogous to how the iPhone's touchscreen beat smarter-but-clunkier predecessors.
companies.arr_source_note: Pre-revenue, government/defense contracts.

funding.source_note: $71M seed, led by Index Ventures and Ribbit Capital, with participation from Conviction Partners. Notable individual investors include Assaf Rappaport (Wiz co-founder/CEO), Merav Bahat (Dazz founder) via Stardust, Sarah Guo, plus executives and researchers from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google DeepMind, xAI, Thinking Machines, Cognition, Factory, and Wiz. Source: TechCrunch, Calcalist, Tech in Asia (Jul 27, 2026).

companies.name: Google DeepMind
companies.intro: Google DeepMind is Google's AI research arm, formed by the 2023 merger of DeepMind and Google Brain. Now the engine behind Google's Gemini family of frontier models, the Gemini Enterprise platform, and a rapidly expanding set of AI research products including Deep Research, Gemini for Science, and Gemini Omni. Acquired by Google in 2014.
companies.product: Gemini 3.1 Pro and 3.5 Flash (latest frontier LLMs). Gemini Omni (multimodal video generation). Gemini Enterprise (agentic platform for business). Gemini for Science (hypothesis generation, computational discovery, literature insights). Deep Research / Deep Research Max agents. Lyria 3 (audio/music). Nano Banana 2 (image). TPU v8 infrastructure. Gemini Agent Platform for enterprise.
companies.arr_source_note: Google DeepMind's revenue is consolidated within Alphabet. Gemini API revenue not separately disclosed.

funding.source_note: Acquired by Google (now Alphabet) in 2014 for ~$500M. Now a division of Alphabet, no external funding. Source: Alphabet Inc. annual reports.

companies.name: Luma AI
companies.intro: Luma AI is the creator of Dream Machine, a leading AI video generation platform with 30M+ registered users. In November 2025, raised $900M Series C led by Saudi Arabia's Humain at a $4B+ valuation. The company is building 'world models' for visual understanding and generation, with access to a 2-gigawatt supercluster through its partnership with Humain. Used by 5 of the 6 major studios.
companies.product: Ray 3 / Ray 3.14 (the first 'reasoning' video model, with self-evaluation iterations, native 16-bit HDR, 1080p resolution). Dream Machine consumer platform. Project Halo: 2GW GPU supercluster partnership with Humain. Ray 3.2: frame-by-frame directorial control. Plans to release Ray 3.1 with 2K HDR output. 30M+ users, 1M in first 4 days of Dream Machine launch.
companies.arr_source_note: Luma AI does not publicly disclose ARR. 30M+ users on consumer platform.

funding.source_note: $900M Series C extension led by Humain, with AMD Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz. Total raised ~$1.07B. Previous $43M Series B (Jan 2024) + $90M Series C (Dec 2024). Source: TheWrap, Morphed, CNBC.

companies.name: Manus AI
companies.intro: Manus is an autonomous AI agent platform that independently executes complex multi-step tasks based on natural language instructions. Originally incubated by Beijing Butterfly Effect Technology, it relocated core team to Singapore in July 2025 and reached $100M+ ARR by December 2025. Meta acquired Manus in December 2025 for $2-3B, but the deal was blocked by China's NDRC in April 2026, leading to a buyback effort at the same $2B valuation.
companies.product: Autonomous AI agent platform — Manus can execute complex multi-step tasks end-to-end (data analysis, sales automation, research, content creation). Subscription tiers: Starter $39/month, Pro $199/month. Built on Claude 3.7 Sonnet initially. Multi-task support with concurrent execution. Direct competitor to OpenAI Operator and Anthropic Computer Use.
companies.arr_source_note: Sacra estimate: Manus hit $450M ARR in June 2026, up from $127M earlier in 2025.

funding.source_note: Series B $75M led by Benchmark in April 2025 at $500M valuation (pre-Meta). Meta acquisition of ~$2B in Dec 2025; **China NDRC ordered deal unwound April 27, 2026**. Butterfly Effect (parent) closed $500M+ round **Oct 8, 2026**, co-led by Boyu Capital + IDG Capital with Tencent, HSG (Sequoia China), ZhenFund. **Valuation NOT disclosed** (reports suggested $4B target). Hong Kong IPO reportedly being considered. Source: Reuters, Agentry, Every One Needs A Samwise (Oct 8, 2026).

companies.name: Microsoft Research Asia (MSRA)
companies.intro: Microsoft Research Asia, established in 1998, is Microsoft's research arm in the Asia-Pacific region. Operates labs in Beijing, Shanghai, Vancouver, Tokyo, Singapore, and Hong Kong. The lab has trained generations of AI researchers and contributed foundational work to computer vision, NLP, and deep learning. Now operating with research hubs across Asia, focused on AI foundations and applications.
companies.product: MSRA StarTrack Scholars Program (2026 open for applications), research collaboration with global universities, published research across computing fundamentals, intelligent interactions, multi-modal perception, AI and society, AI for industry and science. Key 2026 themes: AI-transformed medical research, Agentic AI, Brain/AI integration, AI-era systems, Societal AI, Spatial Intelligence. No commercial product — research output feeds into Microsoft products.
companies.arr_source_note: Research division of Microsoft. No separate ARR.

funding.source_note: Subsidiary of Microsoft. No external funding. Source: Microsoft Research.

companies.name: Mistral AI
companies.intro: Mistral AI is Europe's leading independent AI lab, founded by three former Google and Meta researchers. Has scaled to $400M ARR in January 2026 and is in talks to raise ~€3B at €20B valuation (June 2026). Differentiated by open-weight approach, European data sovereignty positioning, and aggressive efficiency. Targets $1B+ revenue in 2026.
companies.product: Mistral Medium 3.5 (flagship, agentic), Mistral Large 3 (mixture-of-experts, 41B/675B params, Apache 2.0), Magistral (reasoning family), Devstral 2 (coding, powers Vibe), Mistral Small 4 (unified), Pixtral (vision), Voxtral (speech, open-source July 2025), Codestral, Ministral (edge). Le Chat/Vibe consumer apps. Forge: on-premises enterprise model training. Building own data centers in France.
companies.arr_source_note: Sacra estimate: Mistral $400M ARR in January 2026.

funding.latest_round: Series C + new round in talks
funding.source_note: Series C €1.7B (~$2B) at €11.7B post-money in Sept 2025, led by ASML. March 2026: $830M debt for Paris data center. June 2026: in talks for €3B at €20B. Total equity ~€2.8B + debt $830M. Source: Mistral, TechCrunch, Sacra, The AI Rankings.

companies.name: Moonshot AI
companies.intro: Moonshot AI is one of China's leading AI labs, founded by former Meta AI and Google Brain researcher Yang Zhilin. The company develops the Kimi family of models, with Kimi K2.5/K2.6 topping global coding benchmarks. Total raised $3.9B in 6 months leading up to mid-2026, with a $30B valuation being discussed for a new round. Just released Kimi K3, the world's largest open-weight model (2.8T parameters).
companies.product: Kimi K3 (flagship, 2.8T params, open-weight, comparable to US frontier models). Kimi K2.7 Code (specialized coding, $0.95/$4 per million tokens). Kimi K2.6 (general-purpose, second-most used on OpenRouter). Chat interface at kimi.com. Backed by Alibaba, Tencent, Meituan. Plans Hong Kong IPO.
companies.arr_source_note: Moonshot does not publicly disclose ARR.

funding.latest_round: Series F (closed) + Series G pre-IPO in progress
funding.source_note: Series F closed at $35B post-money late July 2026 (~$3.5B raised). Series G pre-IPO round opened with $50B pre-money target (Aug 2026). Targeting Hong Kong IPO as soon as late 2026; ARR ~$300M targeting $2B by year-end. Existing investors: Alibaba, Tencent, IDG, Meituan. Source: Caixin Global, Stock Analysis, Bloomberg (Sept 11-18, 2026).

companies.name: Openmind Research Institute
companies.intro: Openmind Research Institute is a non-profit AI research organization founded by Richard Sutton, Turing Award-winning pioneer of reinforcement learning and professor at the University of Alberta. The institute funds researchers following the 'Alberta Plan' for human-level AI agents. All work is open-source; Openmind does not pursue IP rights.
companies.product: Research fellowships: funds researchers working on the Alberta Plan (12-step framework for AI agents capable of human-level intelligence). Focuses on reinforcement learning research. Governing board: Richard Sutton, Randy Goebel (U of A), Joseph Modayil (ex-DeepMind). Research agenda is independent of funding sources. Will not pursue IP rights — all output is open-source.
companies.arr_source_note: Non-profit research institute. No revenue.

funding.source_note: $4.8M from Huawei Canada. Government of Canada restricted Huawei's ability to work with publicly-funded universities, which prompted the non-profit structure. Source: Globe and Mail, Dec 2025.

companies.name: Periodic Labs
companies.intro: Periodic Labs is an AI startup founded by Liam Fedus (former OpenAI VP) and Ekin Dogus Cubuk (ex-Google DeepMind). Building AI scientists that operate autonomous robotic labs to conduct materials science experiments, with first goal of developing higher-temperature superconductors. Raised $300M seed in October 2025 (largest seed round at the time) and in talks for $500M+ at $7.5B valuation in May 2026 — a ~6x jump in 8 months.
companies.product: AI scientist + automated robotic lab system. First product: AI-driven materials science research. Autonomous powder synthesis labs using robots to carry out research tasks. Each materials science experiment can produce several GB of data used to train AI models. Initial focus: superconductors operating at higher temperatures (applications: more efficient chips, power grid). Collaborating with semiconductor sector.
companies.arr_source_note: Pre-revenue research stage.

funding.source_note: Seed $300M led by a16z in October 2025 at $1.3B post-money. May 2026: in talks for $500M+ at $7.5B (~6x). Oversubscribed. Angels: Jeff Bezos, Eric Schmidt, Jeff Dean, Elad Gil, OpenAI (considered). Source: SiliconAngle, Forbes, LinkedIn.

companies.name: Preferred Networks
companies.intro: Preferred Networks (PFN) is Japan's leading independent AI company, established in 2014 by University of Tokyo computer scientists. A vertically integrated developer of AI semiconductors, computing infrastructure, generative AI, and specific AI solutions. Developed PLaMo (Japanese-optimized LLM) and MN-Core processors. Recently joined the Noetra consortium with SoftBank, Sony, NEC, Honda for Japan's national AI project, receiving ~¥1T (~$6.1B) in 5-year government support.
companies.product: PLaMo (proprietary LLM trained on Japanese data, PLaMo 3.0 Prime priced at <50% of OpenAI for Japanese). Kachaka (autonomous mobile robot). PLaMo Light & PLaMo 100B (open-weight). Real-world control systems for oil refineries. MN-Core AI processors. New NEDO project: multimodal Physical AI foundation model with Noetra. Joint research with Toyota Frontier Research Center and MHI for defense applications.
companies.arr_source_note: PFN revenue not publicly disclosed. Sells PLaMo API and Kachaka robots.

funding.source_note: No direct PFN equity raise of this size. The ¥1T (~$6.1B) 5-year figure refers to a Japan METI/NEDO grant to Noetra (consortium led by SoftBank, Sony, NEC, Honda, with PFN contributing engineers to the PLaMo model team). Confirmed FY2026 commission is ¥387.3B (~$2.4B) to Noetra; PFN is a participating member, not the direct grant recipient. PFN-level capital commitments are via partnerships with Mitsubishi Heavy (June 2026) and Toyota Frontier Research. No public PFN equity raise amount on record. amount_usd and total_raised_usd left null to avoid overstating PFN-specific capital.

companies.name: Prometheus
companies.intro: Prometheus (formerly Project Prometheus) is a physical AI startup co-founded by Jeff Bezos and Vik Bajaj (former Verily/Google co-founder). The company is building an 'artificial general engineer' — AI that automates the design and manufacturing of complex physical systems. Raised $12B Series B at $41B valuation in June 2026, making it one of the most richly valued AI startups ever funded. ~150 employees across SF, London, Zurich.
companies.product: AI tools for hardware development and physical engineering. Not robotics (Bezos clarified). Focus on prototyping and pre-production manufacturing. Very version of CAD — a system to accelerate the 'invention loop'. Acquired General Agents Inc. (AI agent for multistep computer use). Product details kept under wraps.
companies.arr_source_note: Pre-product, pre-revenue.

funding.source_note: Series B $12B at $41B valuation. Previous $6.2B raise. Total raised $18.2B. Backed by Bezos, JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, BlackRock, DST Global, Arch Venture Partners. Source: TechCrunch, SiliconAngle, Axios.

companies.name: Safe Superintelligence
companies.intro: Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI) is the pure-play AI research lab founded by Ilya Sutskever (OpenAI co-founder, former chief scientist) with Daniel Gross and Daniel Levy. The highest-valued AI lab with no commercially available product. Raised $6B total at $32B valuation. Thesis: scaling has plateaued, the next breakthrough requires fundamentally different algorithms, not more GPUs. ~20 employees.
companies.product: No commercial product. The company's sole deliverable is the eponymous goal: safe superintelligence. Sutskever publicly stated 'the first product will be the safe superintelligence, and it will not do anything else up until then.' Research focus on a new paradigm beyond scaling — algorithmic innovation as the next lever. No enterprise contracts, no API, no consumer product.
companies.arr_source_note: Zero revenue, no commercial product.

funding.source_note: $2B at $32B in April 2025, led by Greenoaks. Earlier $1B seed at $5B in September 2024. Total $6B. Strategic investors: Alphabet, Nvidia. Source: TechCrunch, Globe and Mail, Calcalist, Wikipedia.

companies.name: Sakana AI
companies.intro: Sakana AI is Tokyo's leading AI research lab, founded by former Google researchers Llion Jones, Ren Ito, and David Ha. Focuses on nature-inspired AI (model merging, evolutionary algorithms) and Japanese-language optimization. Valued at $2.7B after Series B + strategic rounds. Has secured $479M+ in total funding and counts MUFG, Daiwa Securities, Mitsubishi Electric, Google, Salesforce, and Citi as strategic partners. Most valuable private AI startup in Japan as of June 2026.
companies.product: Sakana Fugu (enterprise multi-agent orchestration API, GA June 2026), Sakana Chat (consumer chatbot for Japan), Namazu model series (post-training of open-weight models like DeepSeek, Llama). AI for Science (AlphaEvolve, ERA). Multi-year strategic partnerships with MUFG (bank-specific AI), Daiwa Securities (wealth management), Mitsubishi Electric (manufacturing). 2025 revenue ~$30M.
companies.arr_source_note: Contrary Research unverified estimate: ~$30M in 2025.

funding.source_note: Series B (Nov 2025) $135M + strategic rounds from Google, Citi, Mitsubishi Electric totaling $200M+. $479M+ total. Source: Sakana AI, TechCrunch, Clay, Contrary Research, SiliconAngle.

companies.name: SandboxAQ
companies.intro: SandboxAQ is an enterprise B2B AI/quantum company spun out of Alphabet in 2022. Led by Jack Hidary (former Google AI/quantum lead), the company builds Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) — a complement to LLMs for science and business problems in drug discovery, materials science, cybersecurity, navigation, and medical devices. Has raised >$950M total. Recently announced a Pentagon AI cyber contract.
companies.product: Large Quantitative Models (LQMs) for life sciences, financial services, navigation, and other sectors. Cybersecurity AI products (recent Pentagon contract). Drug discovery & materials science AI. Solutions at the intersection of AI and quantum techniques — addressing problems where LLMs alone are insufficient.
companies.arr_source_note: SandboxAQ does not publicly disclose ARR.

funding.source_note: CHIPS and Science Act R&D award of $500M (definitive agreement June 17, 2026). In exchange, US Dept of Commerce receives a minority, non-voting equity stake. R&D scope: PFAS-free process chemicals, catalysts, rare earth-free magnets, fab backup batteries. Prior priced equity: $300M+ in Dec 2024 at $5.3B pre-money. Total traditional equity raised >$950M since 2022 Alphabet spinoff. CHIPS award is excluded from funding.total_raised_usd because it is an R&D grant + government minority equity, not a primary priced round.

companies.name: ServiceNow
companies.intro: ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Q4 2025 subscription revenue $3.47B (+21% YoY); full-year 2025 $12.9B (+20%). The Now Assist AI product surpassed $600M annual contract value (ACV) in Q4 2025, on track for $1B by 2026. Acquired Moveworks in December 2025 to bolster enterprise conversational AI capabilities.
companies.product: Now Platform: IT service management, customer service, CRM, HR, DevOps, finance, supply chain. Now Assist: AI assistant for service management, customer service, CRM, DevOps, sales — targeted for $1B ACV by 2026. Workflow Data Fabric, Raptor, CPQ, App Engine. Now Assist encompasses the entire ServiceNow suite as a single AI layer. Acquired Moveworks (December 2025) for enterprise search and conversational AI.
companies.arr_source_note: ServiceNow FY2025 total revenue $12.9B (10-K filing).

funding.source_note: Public company (NYSE: NOW). Market cap ~$200B. Pre-IPO funding ~$5M. Source: ServiceNow Q4 2025 earnings.

companies.name: Snowflake
companies.intro: Snowflake (NYSE: SNOW) is the AI Data Cloud, helping customers consolidate data, build AI applications, and share data. Q4 FY2026 product revenue $1.23B (+30% YoY), full-year $4.47B (+29% YoY). 13,328 customers with 9,100+ using Cortex AI. Recently launched Cortex Code (AI coding agent) and acquired TensorStax for AI-driven data engineering within Cortex. Net revenue retention 125%.
companies.product: AI Data Cloud: Snowflake platform, Snowpark, Cortex AI (managed AI layer bringing LLMs, ML, and AI functions to governed data), Cortex Code (AI coding agent for data systems, extends CLI to data systems). 430+ new capabilities in FY2026. Industries: financial services, healthcare, retail, public sector, adtech. Powers data pipelines, AI/ML workloads, secure data sharing.
companies.arr_source_note: Snowflake FY2026 product revenue $4.47B (10-K filing).

funding.source_note: Public company (NYSE: SNOW). IPO Sep 2020. Pre-IPO funding ~$1.4B. Source: Snowflake S-1, FY2026 earnings.

companies.name: StepFun
companies.intro: StepFun is a Shanghai-based AI startup founded by Jiang Daxue (former Microsoft VP). The company develops large foundation models and focuses on the 'AI + terminals' strategy, embedding AI directly into hardware like cars, smartphones, and robots. Raised ~$719M Series B+ in January 2026 from state-owned investors. Has close ties with Geely Automobile (jointly developed smart cockpits for mass-produced models).
companies.product: Step 3 flagship large language model, plus multimodal systems processing text and visual inputs together. High inference efficiency for both cloud and on-device deployment. Key products: Agent OS smart cockpit with Geely (end-to-end voice model). Plans to deploy in 1M+ vehicles. Goal: bridge cloud AI and device AI for automotive, smartphones, and robotics.
companies.arr_source_note: StepFun does not publicly disclose ARR.

funding.source_note: Closed $2.5B funding round Aug 4, 2026, ahead of Hong Kong IPO (seeking $12B valuation per June 2026 reports). Co-led by Shanghai SDIC Leading Fund and China Life Private Equity. State-owned investors. Previous Series B+ was ~CNY 5B (~$719M) in early 2026, with Tencent, Qiming, 5Y Capital participating.

companies.name: Thinking Machine Labs
companies.intro: Thinking Machines Lab is Mira Murati's (former OpenAI CTO) AI research lab, founded in February 2025. Closed the largest seed round in AI history at $2B for $12B valuation in July 2025. Attempted a $50B valuation round that fell through in January 2026. Sits at $12B with 140-169 employees. Has shipped two products: Tinker (developer platform) and TML-Interaction-Small (first 'interaction model').
companies.product: Tinker: developer platform for running and customizing open-source models. TML-Interaction-Small: first 'interaction model' (May 2026) — AI that processes input and generates output simultaneously, allowing interruption mid-response. Responds in 0.40 seconds, matching human conversation latency. Architecture: single network trained to listen, speak, see, and pause from the start. Infrastructure deals with Nvidia (Vera Rubin chips) and Google (multi-billion $).
companies.arr_source_note: Pre-revenue research stage.

funding.source_note: Seed $2B at $12B post-money in July 2025 (largest AI seed). $50B talks in Nov 2025 collapsed Jan 2026. Maintains $12B valuation. Source: Reuters, TechCrunch, Bloomberg, StartupHub.ai.

companies.name: Wonderful AI
companies.intro: Wonderful is an Israeli enterprise AI agent platform founded in 2025 by Bar Winkler (CEO) and Roey Lalazar (CTO). Just one year old, the company has raised $280M+ total funding and is valued at $2B (Series B March 2026 led by Insight Partners). Their AI agents handle 80% of customer service requests autonomously across 30+ countries. Plans to scale from 350 to 900 employees by year-end.
companies.product: Enterprise AI agent platform: customer-facing AI agents for voice, chat, and email in every market and every language. Agents plug deeply into customer's existing software and can be tailored per market. Currently managing tens of thousands of customer requests daily with 80% resolve rate. Plans to expand beyond customer support into employee training, sales enablement, regulatory compliance, internal IT support, and onboarding.
companies.arr_source_note: Subscription model, not publicly disclosed.

funding.source_note: Series B $150M led by Insight Partners in March 2026 at $2B. Earlier $34M seed (July 2025) and $100M Series A (November 2025). Total ~$284M. Investors: Index Ventures, IVP, Bessemer, Vine Ventures. Source: Calcalist, Yahoo Finance, Bloomberg.

companies.name: Workato
companies.intro: Workato is the leader in Enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic orchestration, posting 35% YoY ARR growth and 50% Net New ARR growth in FY26 (ending Jan 2026). 700+ customers contribute $100K+ in ARR. Built the industry's first Enterprise MCP platform that turns workflows/integrations/APIs into agent-ready skills. Total funding: $70M Series C + $110M Series D + earlier.
companies.product: Workato ONE: enterprise-grade AI agent platform. Enterprise MCP (turns existing workflows into agent-ready skills callable by any LLM agent). 100+ production-ready MCP servers across communication, productivity, sales, IT ops. Action Board, Developer Sandbox, and Genies (enterprise AI agents). Integration-led automation for core operating workflows. Strategic investors include Salesforce, ServiceNow, Workday, MS Teams ecosystem partners.
companies.arr_source_note: Workato does not publicly disclose ARR. Reports 35% YoY growth.

funding.source_note: Series D $110M at $1.7B led by Altimeter with Insight Partners. Series C $70M (Redpoint, Norwest, Geodesic). Earlier seed/Series A. Total ~$200M. Source: Workato blog.

companies.name: Zhipu AI
companies.intro: Zhipu AI (internationally branded Z.ai) is the world's first listed LLM company — debuted on Hong Kong Stock Exchange (HKEX: 2513) on January 8, 2026. The company is one of China's 'AI tigers' and the largest independent LLM developer in China. Spun out of Tsinghua University in 2019. Recently hit HK$1T (~$128B) market cap on the strength of GLM-5.2 release. On the US Entity List since January 2025.
companies.product: GLM model family (MIT-licensed open weights): GLM-5.2 (flagship, ~753B-param MoE, 1M context, agentic coding focus, June 2026), GLM-5 series, GLM-4.7, GLM Coding Plan. Z.ai assistant (consumer). BigModel API platform. AutoGLM (device-control agent). Specialist models: CogVideoX, CogView, CodeGeeX. 12,000+ enterprise customers, 80M+ end-user devices, 45M+ developers.
companies.arr_source_note: Zhipu 2025 revenue ~RMB 724M (~$105M, +132% YoY) per debut annual results.

funding.source_note: IPO Jan 8 2026 at HK$116.20/share, raised ~HK$4.17B (~$537M), retail-oversubscribed 1,000x. Pre-IPO lifetime funding ~$1.5B from Alibaba, Tencent, Ant, Meituan, Xiaomi, Hillhouse, Qiming, Aramco's Prosperity7. July 2026: ~$4B follow-on share placement. Sept 13, 2026: $5B financing package ($2B share placement at HK$714/share + $3B zero-coupon convertible bonds due Sept 2027). 60% of proceeds for next-gen GLM models + fully self-training system. Source: Reuters, KuCoin News, Seoul Economic Daily, Chosun (Sept 13-14, 2026).
